	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = target
		name = "choose_country"
		interaction_source_list = {
			international_organization:antq_germanic_frontier_exchanges = {
				every_international_organization_member = { add_to_list = source }
			}
		}
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			this != scope:actor
			is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:antq_germanic_frontier_exchanges
		}
	}
	allow = {
		exists = scope:target
		scope:actor = { gold >= 10 }
		scope:target = {
			this != scope:actor
			is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:antq_germanic_frontier_exchanges
		}
	}
	cooldown = { type = antq_send_frontier_envoys years = 5 }
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			add_gold = -10
			add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus
		}

			if = {
				limit = { this != scope:actor }
